newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields rise, crown stronger at noon.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields rise, crown stronger at noon.

text.p: Yields were marginally higher and the crown strengthened by midday on Tuesday in very quiet trade.
The crown firmed when Swedish export companies sold currencies against the crown. One dealer said the crown seemed to be trading between 4.56 and 4.57 crowns to the mark.
The crown firmed to 4.5635 crowns to the mark versus 4.5730 crowns on Monday.
The six month T-bill rate was flat at 4.29 percent and the ten year bond yield was one basis point higher at 7.23 percent.
The Riksbank announced a repo tender today and left the rate unchanged at 4.10 percent which was in line with market expectations.
